research_scope: Invented L10_SYNTHETIC_DEV events; 12 DEV_FIT records and 12 DEV_CHECK records, 3 known development families. No WebNLG or prospective unfamiliar source.

frozen_admission.cross_os_numeric_difference_reason: Platform-dependent peak traced Python-memory measurement; underlying event and state SHA256 and scored accuracies/abstentions are equal. Do not assert byte identity of full resource-containing receipts.

experimental_design.fairness: All learning methods observe exactly the same 24 relation-code/effect-channel pairs, with public effect-channel semantics. DEV_CHECK provides only opaque relation codes with no code-to-meaning lexicon and no consequence feedback.

research_disposition.bounded_positive: The local state updates incrementally from observed consequences; exact serialization and restore preserve the associations and support generalization to new development entity bindings and compositions under a stationary code/effect mapping.
research_disposition.strict_negative: Strong equally informed batch conditional-frequency and Dirichlet-MAP baselines score exactly the same in every regime. No Pareto gain, native causal abstraction, unfamiliar source-family transfer or general-language competence demonstrated.
research_disposition.information_sufficiency: Withholding effect information leads all methods to abstain; substituting incorrect feedback creates confidently wrong claims, so lack of abstention is not correctness.
frozen_weaknesses: Synthetic sensor effect labels explicitly reveal semantic information; this is not unsupervised meaning discovery.
DEV_FIT and DEV_CHECK share three source family definitions; there is no qualified unfamiliar family holdout.
Local updating vs batch fitting differs in update schedule, not in learned conditional frequency representation.
Sensor feedback was deterministically correct, absent or systematically permuted; real noise/drift and exploration not evaluated.
Complete resource/energy/FLOPs and independent end-to-end matched Pareto comparisons unavailable; platform peak-memory measures differ.
Online and classical states are content-addressed but test harness does not establish independent hermetic process sandboxing.

next_gate: Mechanism-level stopping: preserve exact qualified local learning as a bounded feasibility positive and conventional parity negative. For future advancement, preregister a genuinely state-dependent nontrivial learning/adaptation task with active information acquisition, delayed consequence, interference/restart retention and strong equally informed conventional controls; separately qualify prospective independent source family and complete costs before L10-C. Do not modify the frozen L9 findings.
